title: Financial Hardship Ladder and Program Periods — Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility
content:
Summit Ridge's financial-hardship program for **Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility** accounts uses one ladder and three periods, identical in all seven payer classes: Original Medicare Part B, Medicare Advantage HMO, Medicare Advantage PPO, Medicaid Fee-for-Service, Commercial HMO, Commercial PPO and Medicare Supplement Plan G.

## Hardship ladder (every payer class)

Household income is expressed as a percentage of the federal poverty level and compared with the rows in order; the first matching row wins, and income above the last row earns no discount.

| Row | Household income at or below (percent of the federal poverty level) | Hardship tier | Discount on patient responsibility (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 200 | full-100 | 100 |
| 2 | 250 | partial-75 | 75 |
| 3 | 300 | partial-50 | 50 |
| 4 | 400 | partial-25 | 25 |
| — | above 400 | no tier | no discount |

## Program periods (every payer class)

| Period | Length |
|---|---|
| Income documentation must be received within | 30 calendar days after the hardship application is submitted |
| A hardship approval stays in force | 12 calendar months from its approval date |
| Already-posted open charges also receive the discount when posted within | 180 calendar days before the hardship approval date |

## Matching examples (hypothetical incomes)

| Documented income (percent of the poverty level) | First matching row | Tier |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | row 1 (at or below 200) | full-100 |
| 201 | row 2 (at or below 250) | partial-75 |
| 300 | row 3 (at or below 300) | partial-50 |
| 400 | row 4 (at or below 400) | partial-25 |
| 401 | none | no tier |
